title: YetiChaos: Yeti Research
description: Study the Yeti, discover its daily routine, and uncover the story of the photographers before you... if they are still alive. Collect all the photos and stay out of the blizzard.
body:
![tent](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d6e3643cb664d3720b8444dfa89c972723da9f7_0.webp)

---

YetiChaos is an atmospheric exploration mod where your goal is to study the mysterious Yeti, capture its rare behaviors on camera, and uncover the chilling mystery of the lost photographers who came before you.
